dct_description_sm: Two protected areas were created via the North Yukon Land Use Plan: the Whitefish Habitat Protection Area and a territorial park around the Bell River - Summit Lake region. For the Habitat Protection Area, a management plan needed to be created. The Yukon Government and the Vuntut Gwichin Government approached Ducks Unlimited Canada to provide information on waterfowl values, particularly moulting waterfowl. A three day survey was conducted to determine the abundance, species diversity, and location of moulting waterfowl. For the territorial park at Bell River - Summit Lake, the final boundaries are still open to negotiation. A waterfowl survey was conducted to determine waterfowl use of the area during the moulting period and a reconnaissance of the wetlands in the Bell River valley was conducted. Recommendations on boundary location were made with the intent of preserving the hydrological connectivity of the wetlands and thus conserving habitat for waterfowl. This project was supported by the North Yukon Program.
dct_title_s: Moulting waterfowl survey in northern Yukon, 2010
